summary: Frontend-only regression sweep AFTER iter 386-390 refactor (App.js 5230→2531 lines, panels extracted). Verified login, dashboard KPIs, all 9 sidebar sections expand, 14 critical refactored views (including AIResponsePanel-hosting reviews, templates, approval-queue, api-connection, webhooks, integrations, branding, team, alerts/reports, help-guide), forecast-v2 Segmentler tab, housekeeping Tahminsel/predictive-hk-panel, hurdle-lrv panel, command palette, notification bell container, public booking page with social proof badge. action_items: Minor: React 'unique key prop' warning emitted from CommandPalette children — cosmetic, no functional impact but should be fixed by adding stable keys.
Two 401 responses on initial /login page load (likely /me probe when unauthenticated) — expected but could be silenced to reduce console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js still 2531 lines — further split by domain (Reservations panels, Finance panels) recommended in future iterations.
Some views (webhooks/branding/reports/analytics) render very lightweight content (<500 chars main) — verify these are indeed pass-through to dialogs/modals and not degraded post-refactor.
Section auto-navigate-on-open behavior (App.js:656-658) may surprise users who expect chevron to only toggle collapse; consider separate chevron button.
